Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical guide page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The hill parking paragraph points to a graphic for the wheel direction on uphill and downhill grades with and without a curb; the graphic has no extractable text, so only the general toward-the-roadside rule is taught [A02] (verify MO-PARK-D-HILLGRAPHIC).
The International Symbol of Access is shown as a picture; only its written meaning was used [A02].
The fine range for disability parking misuse is restated and isolated as dynamic [A02].
Colored curb meanings other than yellow are not explained in the selected pages, and none were added [A01].
